source: Aesthetic presets from the user's brief, grounded in what Primitive, Creature, Fucking Awesome / Hockey, Urban Outfitters men's graphic tees and GQ's summer-2026 graphic-tee picks sell. Settings are defaults only; every toggle stays editable.
unsupportedNote: Puff, glow-in-the-dark, foil, flock, rhinestone and UV color-change prints can't be reproduced with DTF. Ask a screen printer or a specialty vinyl shop.

presets.name: Skate flat-color
presets.description: Posterize to a few flat colors, hard edges, a 3 px outline, no gradients, garment color knocked out.

presets.name: Horror / metal
presets.inspiredBy: Creature x Cannibal Corpse, Hellraiser, Bonehead, Doom Skull
presets.description: Black-dominant art on a black tee: maximum contrast, every near-black knocked out so the shirt becomes the black, whites plus one accent kept, light cracked distress.

presets.name: Distressed relic
presets.inspiredBy: Creature "Relic" logos, Urban Outfitters vintage reprints
presets.description: Coarse scratch distress at about 40%, slightly desaturated, aggressive speck removal so no loose bits wash off.

presets.name: Vintage band / tour tee
presets.inspiredBy: UO Metallica and Soundgarden tour reprints, J.Crew vintage wash
presets.description: Photo halftoned at 50 LPI, cracked distress, faded palette. Looks best on washed or mineral blanks.

presets.name: Stamp / outline logo
presets.inspiredBy: FA stamp, drip and outline logos; Creature Logo Outline
presets.description: Single color, threshold to 1-bit, clean edges, small placement.

presets.name: Halftone photo / screen-tone
presets.description: Turns a photo into a one-ink halftone at 55 LPI (black ink on light garments, white ink on dark ones). No soft alpha.

presets.name: Hand-drawn ink
presets.description: Threshold to line art keeping the line weight, 1 to 2 colors, paper white knocked out.

presets.name: Collage / zine / xerox
presets.description: High-contrast cutouts with a white keyline around each piece and light speckle. The keyline is 4 px (about 0.013 in) at 300 DPI because a true 1 px line won't hold on film.

presets.name: Old English / blackletter type
presets.inspiredBy: Primitive Realm and Arena boxy tees
presets.description: Crisp type edges, a keyline, flat fill, and strokes thickened to meet the 0.04 in minimum.

presets.name: Collegiate / preppy club
presets.inspiredBy: GQ's preppy picks, UO college colorblock hoodies
presets.description: Arched block type in 2 to 3 flat colors with a light vintage-wash distress. Best on cream, heather or sand.

presets.name: Sports throwback
presets.inspiredBy: Mitchell & Ness cream champions tee, UO NFL vintage
presets.description: Retro palette limited to 4 colors with cracked ink, on a cream or heather base.

presets.name: Playful / tongue-in-cheek
presets.description: Simple color illustration with clean edges and no distress. Best on light garments.

presets.name: Small front / big back
presets.description: Exports two files from the same art: a 3.5 in left chest and a 12 in full back.

presets.name: Fade into garment
presets.inspiredBy: Graphic tees where the art dissolves into the shirt
presets.description: One edge fades into the shirt through a halftone alpha gradient, never soft alpha.

presets.name: Washed / mineral garment pairing
presets.description: No change to the art. The mockup shows a mottled finish and the job sheet recommends washed blanks from the catalog.
